body:
A new user on a new machine gets from opening the app to a first task without a terminal, and every problem along the way is explained in plain words with a way to fix it.

### Scope

- A first-run check for the tools Solace needs (Gleam, Erlang, an agent and its sign-in).
- Agent failures (expired sign-in, needed update, missing program) shown as plain messages with a way out.
- Rust and JavaScript projects: a clear account of what Solace offers for them today, and a path to type-checked support for a subset of each language (a long-term goal).

Prebuilt app bundles belong to the **Build tab rollout** milestone (`self-build` tasks). This feature doesn't redo them.
title: Works out of the box
